data.action: 摘下的眼镜放在桌上，双手抓住视角衣袖，抬眼露出惊讶而害羞的浅笑。
data.camera: medium close-up, eye level, sleeve in foreground
data.description: 黄昏的社团活动室里，希耶尔的眼镜已经折好放在书桌上。少了镜片的遮挡，她对上你近在眼前的目光，蓝色眼眸里浮起惊讶，耳根一点点变红。她穿着整齐的藏青校服外套和灰色百褶裙，双手轻轻攥住你递来的衣袖，想要说些什么，又先露出难为情的浅笑。
data.location: 夕阳斜照的无人社团活动室书桌旁
data.promptProse: Folded glasses rest on the clubroom desk beside Ciel, leaving her sapphire eyes unobstructed when she looks up at the viewer. She wears a neat navy blazer, white shirt, red tie and grey pleated skirt. Both hands gather the cuff of the sleeve entering the foreground, and surprise settles into a small embarrassed smile. Warm sunset light touches her short blue hair and reddened ears. Keep her uncovered face and the two hands in a medium close view; the glasses remain on the desk.
data.title: 希耶尔 · 摘下眼镜的慌乱娇羞
